name: Manhunter
body:
They can run from you, but they can’t hide.

Prerequisite(s): Member of the order of the wolf cavalier order

Benefit: You gain a +2 feat bonus to Diplomacy, Perception, Sense Motive and Survival checks made to find the person (humanoid) for whom you are questing. In addition, Knowledge (local) is a class skill for you.
